'''Minotaur''' are found on level one of the [[Stronghold of Security]]. They drop the [[right skull half]], one of four parts of the [[skull sceptre]]. These monsters are great for training due to their low [[Defence]], but have high attack damage making them dangerous for un-equipped players.

Minotaurs are a common method of [[Ranged training]] as they can be [[safespot]]ted and commonly drop iron arrows.

==Tips==
There are various safespots located in the [[Stronghold of Security]]: [[Vault of War]] floor. These spots can be found in the following places: In the small centre room south of the room with the spikey chain, by standing on the east side of the north-westernmost skeleton. In the room immediately east to the start of the floor, behind the spiked fences. and in the large south-easternmost room behind the spiked fence. 

<gallery>
File:Minotaur Safespot.png|Safespot in the centre room south of the spikey chains
File:Mino spot.png|Safespot on the room with the spiked fence
File:Safe mino.png|Safespot at the large south-easternmost room.
</gallery>
